_note_sleeves: Team lead 2026-11-18 (docs/SYSTEM.md section 5; EVIDENCE_LOG E-2026-11-18-04). FULL SIZE, equal risk across the four families in this account (CEF ex-date, units ex-date, special dividends, earnings drift), a family's variants splitting its share, from each sleeve's backtest volatility 2000-06-01 to 2025-12-23 (4.2%, 5.7%, 10.7%, 15.4%, 5.3%, 5.3%, 11.7% a year in the order below the special-dividend pair; ~/quantt_research/pm_alloc_2026-11-18/, gross, unreviewed for the ex-date books), on the $625,000 the 2026-11-16 ruling gave the seven: cef_exdate_after $132,000, cef_exdate_before_after $97,000, units_exdate_after $52,000, units_exdate_before_after $36,000, specdiv_wait $105,000, pead_small_long $96,000; specdiv_wait_small stays capped at $25,000 by its names' capacity (2026-11-16) and the $81,000 that cap frees is NOT moved to another sleeve, so the special-dividend family sits under an equal share. THE LADDER, counted in sessions on which the sleeve held a position: under 20 a QUARTER of full size; 20 to 59 a HALF if fills track the shadow book; from 60 FULL if live P&L is above -1 sigma x sqrt(T), half between -1 and -2 sigma, stopped below -2 sigma. Each sleeve's full_capital_usd is the full size above and its family the idea it is a variant of (both added 2026-11-18 so that the file states them itself; the runner sizes nothing from them). capital_usd is the CURRENT STAGE and the only figure the runner trades (every sleeve at a quarter: no sleeve has a live session); moving a sleeve up or down the ladder is an edit of its capital_usd here in a PR, and `python3 -m quantt.sleeves.promote` (read-only) says which edit is due and refuses a capital_usd that is not full_capital_usd x a quarter, a half or one. STOPPED is enabled=false, which flattens the sleeve. Team lead 2026-11-18 (question prompts; EVIDENCE_LOG E-2026-11-18-24): a clean session is any on-time day, ten in a row; 'fills track' is paper within twice the modelled fill cost; the 60-session sigma is each sleeve's backtest volatility scaled to the capital it traded at. A sleeve is enabled only after its shadow book has 10 clean on-time sessions (no UNMEASURED or LATE day): run the promote report at install and set enabled=false for any that has not. A sleeve's decision weights are fractions of its capital_usd here (the shadow file's own notional is ignored). enabled=false with shares still in the ledger FLATTENS that sleeve; to stop it without trading, halt the book.
